technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Current technology in South Korea

# Included processes
This module includes the auxiliaries and energy efforts as well as the related emissions (air/water) and waste amounts for the assembly of the complete oLED module. Estimations for infrastructure and the overall transport amounts (incl. for the materials in the LCD module) are included as well.
